Competitive Grant Opportunities

Riverbend Early Learning

Grants to improve services for young children in Example County only. Application is open January 5 – March 3, 2027. Learn more.

Winter Shelter Fund

Supports organizations providing emergency shelter during colder months. Application is open November 3 – January 15, 2027. Learn more.

Public Art Sponsorships

The Example Fund promotes visual art appreciation. Sponsorship proposals are considered on a rolling basis. Learn more.

Small Organizations

For small organizations with budgets of $150,000 or less. Funding can support strengthening organizations and program development. The next cycle will be announced. Learn more.

Neighborhood Microgrants

Small awards for resident-led neighborhood projects. Applications are accepted once each spring; contact the foundation for the current cycle.
